title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 PyPI supply-chain compromise
sum: Compromised packages published Oct 21 ran a PRIVCOLLECT credential-stealing payload on Python startup via .pth and sitecustomize.py; redistribution through PyPI and official container images.
ctl: M1045 Code Signing — pin signed artifacts
M1051 Update Software — rebuild images off 1.107.0
M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — hunt PRIVCOLLECT IOCs

title: CISA KEV additions (NetWeaver, Expressway, vCenter, Roller)
sum: CISA added 4 exploited vulns to KEV: SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway hardcoded creds, VMware vCenter auth bypass, Apache Roller deserialization — all confirmed exploited in the wild.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — patch immediately
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — confirm exposure
M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — on all entry points

title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health API flaw exploited since July
sum: Exploited since Jul 23, discovered Nov 9, fixed server-side Nov 19. Exposed admin email addresses, tenant IDs, domain names, license tiers and sync status; no passwords or tokens stolen.
ctl: M1015 Active Directory Configuration — verify tenant sync state
M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — on admin accounts
M1047 Audit — review Entra sign-in and configuration logs

title: Microsoft Nov 2026 Patch Tuesday (1094 CVEs incl. Outlook spoofing)
sum: November Patch Tuesday shipped 1094 CVEs, including CVE-2026-124194 (Outlook spoofing) with exploitation detected.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — apply November updates
M1017 User Training — flag spoofed senders
M1021 Restrict Web-Based Content — narrow email vector

title: FBI NCIC police database reportedly breached
sum: Attackers targeted the National Crime Information Center nationwide police database (warrants, stolen vehicles, missing persons). Scope and access method unclear; second FBI incident in two months.
ctl: M1026 Privileged Account Management — restrict DB access
M1035 Limit Access to Resource Over Network — segment the NCIC boundary
M1047 Audit — baseline DB queries

title: Bell Canada agentic AI-assisted hacker breach
sum: Nov 17 intrusion via a pre-production Maximo system (telecom circuit provisioning). Stole business contact info, IP addresses and ticket titles; described by Bell as an agentic (AI-assisted) attack.
ctl: M1030 Network Segmentation — isolate pre-prod
M1026 Privileged Account Management
M1035 Limit Access to Resource Over Network — gate provisioning systems

title: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard third-party data breach (N0n extortion)
sum: N0n extortion group claims data theft from external service providers holding marketing data (names, emails). No payment infrastructure compromise; customers offered credit monitoring.
ctl: M1057 Data Loss Prevention — on partner data flows
M1022 Restrict File & Directory Permissions
M1029 Remote Data Storage — encrypt third-party shares

title: Austrian Foreign Ministry website hacked
sum: Nov 12-13 breach during a Microsoft global outage; attackers accessed staff contact details including personnel at diplomatic missions abroad. Site operated by an external provider.
act: Austrian Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs
ctl: M1057 Data Loss Prevention
M1026 Privileged Account Management
M1047 Audit — review hosting provider logs

title: BADBOX 3.0 botnet returns (Android TV ad fraud)
sum: BADBOX 3.0 resurfaces on infected Android TV boxes, peaking at 40 billion fraudulent ad bid requests/day (>4% of CTV traffic), 3x VASTFLUX's prior record. HUMAN and partners conducting disruption.
ctl: M1037 Filter Network Traffic — block known C2 ranges
M1054 Software Configuration — disable TI-specific device hooks
M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — ingest BADBOX indicators

title: WhatsApp CVE-2026-23871 exploited in scam campaign
sum: Click-to-WhatsApp ad-reply URL validation flaw on Android before 2.26.17.4 lets scammers make fraud messages appear legitimate and leak victim IPs. Also fixed CVE-2026-102769 (SQLi in order-details messages).
ctl: M1051 Update Software — update WhatsApp for Android
M1017 User Training — verify ad-reply legitimacy
M1035 Limit Access to Resource Over Network — restrict unsolicited clicks

title: Cairn AI framework in autonomous zero-day exploitation
sum: Chinese-nexus actor's exposed Cairn AI pen-test instance used autonomous agents to find a real zero-day in an open-source medical imaging app and gain root access over ~48h, targeting East Asian universities.
ctl: M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — monitor AI-enabled threats
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — on research/edu estates
M1030 Network Segmentation

title: CVE-2026-111497: Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write
sum: Out-of-bounds write in vulnerable Brotli decoders reachable via attacker-controlled compressed data; potential memory disclosure or code execution. No confirmed exploitation.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — apply decoder fixes
M1050 Exploit Protection — enable ASLR/CFG
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — identify Brotli-enabled endpoints

title: Budibase GHSA-25qc-m4pw-2w8r unauth admin creation
sum: Unauthenticated global-admin creation on self-hosted single-tenant instances via a tenant-confusion bypass of the one-time init guard (CVE-2026-122247).
ctl: M1051 Update Software — update Budibase
M1032 Multi-factor Authentication on admin
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — confirm exposure
